claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 micromolar, atorvastatin is expected to inhibit HMG-CoA reductase, depleting mevalonate and downstream isoprenyl lipids, which prevents prenylation of small GTPases and causes selective apoptosis in cancer cell lines dependent on the mevalonate pathway.
